analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($406.11) vs SMA5/20/50 ($394.73/$415.14/$425.04) — trading sideways near the middle band, above short-term SMA5 but below mid-term SMA20/50.
· Position vs SMA100/200 ($396.85/$356.00) — mid-to-long term trend strength is good, above SMA100.
· 52-week position (71.4%) + current price level is about 15% below historical highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (42.4→46.3) + neutral assessment + gentle upward trend.
· MACD histogram trajectory (histo -2.8134→-2.1441) + improvement diagnosis + weak convergence continues.
· Bollinger Band current price position (middle band $415.14) + band width 17.32% indicating moderate volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support line ($386.02) + basis (based on 20-day low).
· Swing resistance line ($414.50) + re-entry into SMA20/50 expected upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (sideways) + lack of trend direction.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.69x vs 5-day average) + decreased reliability of movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (distribution phase) + maintain observation until direction is confirmed.
analysis.patternNote: 현재가 SMA20/50 하회하며 분배구간 흐름을 이어가고 있으며, MACD 히스토그램 개선에도 불구하고 약세 수렴이 지속되어 방향성 확인이 필요한 구간입니다.
analysis.patternNoteEn: The current price is below SMA20/50, continuing the distribution phase, and despite MACD histogram improvement, weak convergence persists, requiring confirmation of direction.
keyPoints: RSI가 46.3으로 중립 구간에서 횡보하며 방향성 부재를 나타내고 있습니다.
MACD 히스토그램이 개선되고 있으나 여전히 음수 구간에 머물러 약세 수렴이 지속되고 있습니다.
5일 평균 대비 거래량 비율이 0.69로 위축되어 있어 현재 움직임의 신뢰도가 낮습니다.
keyPointsEn: RSI is hovering at 46.3 in the neutral zone, indicating a lack of directional momentum.
The MACD histogram is improving but remains in negative territory, suggesting continued weak convergence.
The volume ratio to the 5-day average is 0.69, indicating low confidence in current price movements.
analysis.riskNote: ADX가 18.7로 추세가 형성되지 않은 상태에서 변동성이 나타나고 있어, 급등락 시 추세 전환으로 단정하기 어렵습니다.
analysis.riskNoteEn: With ADX at 18.7, volatility is occurring without a formed trend, making it difficult to definitively call it a trend reversal during sharp price swings.
analysis.continuity: 직전 4거래일 연속 관망 판단이 이어지고 있습니다. 금일도 RSI 중립 구간 횡보 및 MACD 약세 수렴 지속으로 동일한 관망 판단을 유지합니다.
